channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Report: Saudi Arabia strikes bridge in Yemen’s southwestern Taiz province
item.description:
The Houthi-affiliated Al-Masirah channel reported that Saudi Arabia carried out two airstrikes targeting the Al-Barah Bridge in the Makbanah area of Taiz province in southwestern Yemen.
According to the report, this is the second time in two days that the bridge has been targeted.

item.title: Trump: Iran ‘very much’ wants a deal
item.description: President Trump says Iran “very much" wants a deal as he signals the war may be nearing its end and confirms direct contact with Tehran.

item.title: Reports in Lebanon of strikes at several locations in southern part of the country
item.description: Lebanese media reported overnight that strikes were carried out in the villages of Al-Qantara, Al-Nabatieh Al-Fawqa, and Al-Mansouri, as well as in the Wadi Al-Saluki area in southern Lebanon.

item.title: US senators demand Trump release classified Saudi nuclear deal documents
item.description: Bipartisan US senators urge the Trump administration to release classified details of proposed Saudi nuclear deal, including two “side letters."

item.title: The longest and shortest words in the Torah
item.description: We ask Hashem for the blessing of being able to be clever, so that we can use our wisdom to cope well in this world.

item.title: Cyber Directorate warns: Phishing messages impersonating Booking
item.description:
The National Cyber Directorate is warning about phishing messages containing a link to a website impersonating Booking and asking users to confirm a hotel reservation.
The Directorate recommends not clicking the link and instead checking the reservation directly through the official website or app.

item.title: Unusual incident in Kafr Qasim: Stolen IDF LAW missile fired at residential complex
item.description: A LAW missile stolen from the IDF fired at a residential complex in Kafr Qasim. No injuries reported. Police launch a manhunt for suspects.

item.title: Milan Chabad rabbi attacked at bus stop, 3 suspects arrested
item.description: Chabad emissary Rabbi Tzemach Mizrahi assaulted near a Milan bus stop by three men who stole his hat and kicked him. Italian police arrest all three suspects.

item.title: Kansas man arrested for threatening to murder Ben Shapiro on Yom Kippur
item.description: A Kansas man was arrested after allegedly making multiple antisemitic death threats against Jewish right-wing podcaster Ben Shapiro, including an ominous countdown to Yom Kippur.

item.title: Watch: The images the US tried to hide? Damage from Iranian strikes
item.description: Images provided to CBS by US military personnel reveal damage caused to military bases and American property at several sites across the Middle East by Iranian strikes.

item.title: Amit Segal: Saudis ‘don’t pray to Mecca, they pray to Jerusalem’
item.description: Amit Segal highlights the irony of Saudi Arabia reportedly seeking Israeli intelligence against the Houthis after years of publicly criticizing Israel.

item.title: Netanyahu unveils bills targeting those who ‘slander’ IDF soldiers
item.description: Netanyahu announces bills to revoke citizenship from those who slander IDF soldiers and increase potential defamation damages twentyfold following NAZA controversy.

item.title: IDF eliminates three Hamas, Islamic Jihad terrorists planning attacks
item.description: IDF says three terrorists were involved in planting explosives, planning shooting attacks and launching rockets at Israel; strikes carried out to remove immediate threats.

item.title: Hanan Ben Ari surprised by song’s success: “It’s totally crazy, God is a genius"
item.description: Hanan Ben Ari released a live version of “Hashivenu" from his “Hindikim" performance and shared his excitement over the song’s journey: “I discover again and again how little I understand."

item.title: Hezbollah's strategic tunnel system under Ali al-Taher Ridge revealed
item.description: IDF releases new footage from Hezbollah tunnels in the Ali Taher Ridge, where troops uncovered and destroyed strategic terrorist infrastructure.

item.title: IDF Chief: War not yet over, Hezbollah must be removed from south of Litani
item.description: Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir visits 91st Division, says IDF will maintain forward defensive positions inside enemy territory and prevent Hezbollah from rebuilding its capabilities.

item.title: Shin Bet to determine security arrangements for party leaders
item.description: The Ministerial Committee on Shin Bet Affairs decided to authorize the Shin Bet to determine security arrangements for party leaders who do not hold positions entitling them to protection. The authorization will remain in effect until the 26th Knesset is sworn in.

item.title: Samaria shepherd finds hidden monument honoring deadly terrorist
item.description: Shepherd from Tzon Aviezer discovers a monument honoring a terrorist linked to the Emanuel bus massacre; residents demand the IDF demolish it.

item.title: Helmet camera footage: Senior terror operative arrested
item.description: Helmet cameras captured Duvdevan soldiers during a special operation in Burqin, in which a senior member of the Jenin terrorist network was arrested.

item.title: Divorce dispute goes up in flames as alleged arsonist catches fire
item.description: Umm al-Fahm man indicted for allegedly torching a motorcycle during a divorce-related dispute; police say he accidentally set himself on fire during the arson.

item.title: IDF eliminates October 7 terrorist involved in kidnapping three soldiers
item.description: IDF eliminates Hamas Nukhba commander Jihad Ismail, who infiltrated Israel on October 7 and took part in the deadly attack on Tank No. 3 and abduction of its crew.

item.title: ‘A big lie’: Netanyahu rejects claims of Christian persecution
item.description: At memorial ceremony for fallen Arabic-speaking Christian IDF soldiers, Netanyahu rejects claims Israel persecutes minorities and calls the country an ‘island of tolerance.’

item.title: Precedent-setting sentence for man who worked for Iran
item.description: Alexander Granovsky documented power stations and Benny Gantz’s neighborhood, set fire to nine vehicles, and received thousands of dollars from an Iranian agent. He has now been sentenced.

item.title: Reservists answer 100-day call-up, only to learn there’s no budget
item.description: Karmeli Brigade reservists say they left families, jobs and businesses for 100 days of duty, only to face early release because funding was not approved.

item.title: Enforcement operation around new communities
item.description: The Civil Administration removed dozens of illegal structures and encroachments near two new communities in Judea and Samaria.

item.title: Bedouin council head: Eisenkot promised to bring Ra’am into government
item.description: Yashar! party denies claim following meeting with northern Bedouin leaders: 'These things were never said, not even by implication.'

item.title: Benny Gantz in Ma’ale Adumim: E1 corridor is an important strategic security asset
item.description:
Blue and White chairman Benny Gantz toured Ma’ale Adumim and said the E1 corridor, which he said connects the city to Jerusalem, is “an important strategic security asset and an integral part of Jerusalem’s future infrastructure."
He added that the Jerusalem perimeter should receive a comprehensive national response as part of the capital’s metropolitan area.

item.title: “The games are over:" Ben Gvir confronts residents in Bir Hadaj
item.description: The National Security Minister visited Bir Hadaj and confronted residents during the demolition of illegal structures. “Anyone who breaks the law will encounter the enforcement authorities."

item.title: Report: US met Houthis days after terror group seized key coastline
item.description: Reuters reports US officials met Houthi representatives in Oman, where the terror group pledged not to attack American or Israeli vessels.

item.title: Germany: Police investigate death threat against Holocaust survivor
item.description: Police investigating threats against prominent Munich Holocaust survivor and AfD opponent Charlotte Knobloch.
